title: Regenerate an identity provider SCIM token (execute)
description: Step 2 of 2 for regenerate SCIM bearer token. Verifies the confirmation_hash from -prepare and the literal "confirm" string typed by the user, then performs the action. ONLY call this after the user has explicitly typed "confirm" in chat. Original action: Regenerate the SCIM bearer token for an identity provider configuration. The new token is returned once; existing SCIM clients stop working until configured with the new token. This call requires explicit user confirmation.
